- Application & Integration Services
  - CCL reports, PowerInsight, Discern Rules and mPages.
  - FSI/interfaces and integration monitoring.
  - Specialized CCL, FSI, Pharmacy and CareNet resources.
- Operational Services
  - Millennium application and Oracle database operations.
  - Interface, job, print queue and application monitoring.
  - Incident, problem and change management.
  - 24×7 operations and on-call application support.
- Professional Services
  - eSihi uplift and optimization.
  - Service packages, testing and content updates.
  - Training and annual learning services.

- Total Project Duration: 36 months / 3 years.
- Includes subscriptions, software support, professional services and managed services throughout the contract period.

data.oppName: Design Code Platform for Sports Boulevard  Foundation
data.sow:
Business Objective
============
Implement a scalable Enterprise Low-Code Application Platform (LCAP) with Business Process Management (BPM) capabilities to digitize and automate SBF’s Design Code Compliance Process, replacing the current Outlook/SharePoint-based manual process and enabling faster approvals, better visibility, reporting and future workflow automation.     Design Code Platform RFP_Final
Deliverables
========
- Low-Code / BPM Platform
  - Enterprise LCAP and BPM platform.
  - Scalable for future SBF processes and use cases.
- Design Code Compliance Automation
  - Digitize the end-to-end submission, review and approval process.
  - Support external/public stakeholders submitting design information, documents and drawings.
- Workflow & Process Management
  - Automated routing, reviews, approvals and process tracking.
  - Replace manual email/SharePoint-based activities.
- Portal, Reporting & Analytics
  - Public-facing stakeholder interaction.
  - Real-time process tracking, dashboards, reporting and analytics.     Design Code Platform RFP_Final
- Integration & Data
  - APIs and integration with SBF systems.
  - Document/file management and secure handling of drawings and stakeholder data.
- Cybersecurity & Compliance
  - IAM, authentication/authorization, encryption and audit logging.
  - Vulnerability/security monitoring, backup and DR.
  - Compliance with SBF security requirements and applicable Saudi/NCA requirements.
- Implementation Services
  - Platform configuration and workflow development.
  - Integration, testing, deployment and project management.
  - QA/QC plan aligned with ISO 9001 requirements.
Duration
======
Total engagement: 3.5 years
- Implementation: 6 months
- Support & Managed Services: 3 years, commencing after completion of the implementation phase.

Internal Stakeholders
======
- PM
- Managed Services
